source.variation: The published data names letter ळ and contains three ordered path arrays. Stroke 1 has 128 points: it starts at the center junction, sweeps left around the complete left loop and back through the center, then continues right around the complete right loop and returns to the center without lifting. Stroke 2 has 10 points at one x-position and descends from the headline area to the top of the right loop. source.variation: Appendix I Frame 7 numbers six movements in three pen-down runs: joined movements 1–3 form the left body and bar, joined movements 4–5 retrace into the inner upright and broad right bowl, and separate movement 6 forms the detached lower hook. Tamil handwriting varies by school; this is one attested three-run order.
